hosting.//: Deliberately NO ignore patterns. The conventional Firebase defaults --- ['firebase.json', '**/.*', '**/node_modules/**'] --- silently break this build: Expo's web export copies font assets to paths like assets/__node_modules/.pnpm/<pkg>/node_modules/<pkg>/..., so '**/.*' drops everything under .pnpm and '**/node_modules/**' drops the rest. The deploy still succeeds, index.html and the JS bundle still serve 200, and the app then hangs forever on a blank screen because useFonts() never resolves. dist/ is build output; everything in it is meant to ship.
